product.name: Monoprice Premium Home Theater Center Channel Speaker Black
product.description: Get a great sounding center channel speaker to upgrade your current center speaker or to add a second to your system using this Premium Home Theater Center Channel Speaker from Monoprice™!This speaker is identical to the center channel speaker included in our Premium 5.1‑Channel Home Theater Speaker System (PID 10565). It features a 3" polypropylene mid‑range driver and a 0.75" aluminum dome tweeter. It can handle up 100 watts of power and has an impedance of 8 ohms.The speaker handles frequencies from 110Hz ~ 20kHz ±3dB, with the crossover between the mid‑range and tweeter drivers set to 3.5kHz. It measures about 4.3" x 10.2" x 4.3" (HWD) and weighs 3.0 lbs.Support Files: User's Manual (May 8, 2014)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc. Updated Jan 26, 2022 Warning: This product can expose you to Phthalates, which is known to the State of California to cause cancer and reproductive harm. For more information, go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
